name: Manifold Sample
description: Demo consumer mod for Manifold. Registers void + flat + dark + streaming + vault (separate-inventory) + a resettable mining dimension with travel policies and the /voiddim, /flatdim, /darkdim, /streamdim, /vaultdim, /overworlddim, /sendtestitem, /sendtestblock, /createtempdim, /destroytempdim, /miningdim and /miningreset commands, plus a portal block.
